notes.title: Patch Notes V2.1120
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/359bd44e7d3286fec94e6845636d9bb84648b6b1.jpg[/img]

[Quality Of Life]
Clicking a fish when the basket is held will automatically place it inside.

[Bug Fixes]
Fixed a bug where fish would fall into the ocean when transferring them from the fishing net to the boat.
Fish should no longer slip away into the ocean while reeling them in with the rod.

Added more bugs to fix later.

notes.title: V2.1001 A New Update Just Dropped! 🎉
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/e99994e5a298ab1a8339b97a26a8927cdceddcc1.jpg[/img]


Let’s dive right in! We’ve added two new islands to explore. One is fully complete, while the other is still under development—so stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/202db903cffaa6c2991a44f67249b3ce2391bf49.jpg[/img]

Here’s what’s new:
Two new boat upgrades – Available once you purchase the Outpost.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/359bd44e7d3286fec94e6845636d9bb84648b6b1.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/826283360b24945ca35d4d23238a8716d1fb0142.jpg[/img]

New fish species and an all-new rarity tier.

Several smaller islands to discover.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/b9a44a1d1a936a34517adc86d3d8a7dead397079.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/ad9b8c470bdbf4c5ccc916885727b3fbff7b9ce7.jpg[/img]

Hidden treasure digging spots to uncover rewards.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/363041729c71051543e76fcaf979dfdf5f24491a.jpg[/img]


More tools to enhance your adventure:
 A new trap that can catch fish all the way up to legendary rarity.
 A powerful new bait for attracting high-value fish.
 A faster fishing rod—quicker than any previous ones.
 A new shovel that lets you dig up hidden upgrade spots for your character and tools.
 An automatic fishing rod you can place on a level 3 boat—yes, it fishes for you!

A brand new house for the second island.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/9580170e6adf3312952a1cb78299c1f0aa191109.jpg[/img]

An arcade to kick back and have some fun.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/7fdbafa7dcd58f42e6bf77d38393c4f61677c729.jpg[/img]

More trap placement spots on the second island.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/e61a872d69124aee068c4c78e473d5b2be264ca6.jpg[/img]



We also added achievements to the game!

[Adjustments]
We’ve rebalanced the in-game economy—prices have been adjusted to make the experience more welcoming for new players.

That’s it for now—but there’s always more coming soon. Thanks for playing, and happy fishing!

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.1.625
notes.notes:
V1.1.625

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/e6cb3a9f6166313f1bf87b49c1ccfca16f855c3d.png[/img]

[General Updates]
Added a new tutorial.

[Adjustments]

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.1.520
notes.notes:
V1.1.520

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/ddb0b32114d89bdf832b6ac4b0c2a566e7622e0d.png[/img]

[Quality Of Life]
Now you can drop the fish from the basket by pressing LMB.
Added a loading icon when the traps are catching fish.

[adjustments]
The basket price has been reduced from 30 to 15.
Raft speed has been slightly increased.
Adjusted lighting intensity and shadows/dark spots.

[Optimization]
General texture optimization work has been performed.

[Bug fixes]
fixed a bug where sometimes fish don't get attached to the wagon.

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.1.315
notes.notes:
1.02 > V1.1.315

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/ddb0b32114d89bdf832b6ac4b0c2a566e7622e0d.png[/img]

[Quality Of Life]
Now you automatically pick up the fish along with the spear.

[Bug fixes]
Fixed a bug where fish doesn't disappear with the bait.
Fixed a bug where the bait would fall through the world.
Fixed a bug where fish doesn't spawn after throwing the bait.
Fixed a bug where boat animation doesn't work when rotating the boat.

notes.title: Patch Notes V1.02
notes.notes:
1.01 > 1.02

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45185546/ddb0b32114d89bdf832b6ac4b0c2a566e7622e0d.png[/img]

[General Updates]
Now every fish caught with the spear gives you at least 2 coins.
Now the basket can carry up to 5 fish. 
Added more money to the player at the start of the game.
Added resolution option to show all resolutions supported by your monitor.

[Price adjustments]
The basket price has been increased from 25 to 30.
The wagon price has been decreased from 200 to 160.
Money given through loot boxes has been adjusted.

[Optimization]
General optimization work has been performed.

[Bug fixes]
Fixed a bug where selling fish caught with the fishing net would cause you to lose money.
Fixed a bug where fish caught by the fishing net didn't attach to the wagon.
Fixed a bug when pressing Q to drop an item while holding a fish would cause the fish to glitch.
